standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.de_turbo: 蒸馏纠偏（Turbo 向）。推理步数设定多半还在二十多，不是「几步出片」那套。
optionDescriptions.frozen_delta: 底模冻住只训 LoRA，更贴原来的快推味道，能改的幅度也受限。
optionDescriptions.sigma_selective: 只在某段 σ 上训，别的段可能弱。
optionDescriptions.standard: 普通 RF/常规训，跟 de_turbo 假设不一样。

standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.de_turbo: Distillation correction, in the Turbo direction. The inference step count usually still sits in the twenties -- this is not the few-step-and-done regime.
optionDescriptions.frozen_delta: Freezes the base and trains only the LoRA, staying closer to the original fast-inference feel, with a correspondingly limited range of change.
optionDescriptions.sigma_selective: Trains on one band of sigma only, so other bands may come out weak.
optionDescriptions.standard: Ordinary RF / conventional training, which assumes something different from de_turbo.

advanced.principle: Turbo 默认 de_turbo（蒸馏纠偏，推理常需 20-30 步）。Raw 推荐 standard（标准 RF）；若仍选 de_turbo，prepare 会自动落到 standard。frozen_delta：冻底模只训 LoRA（偏保 Turbo 快推）。

advanced_en.principle: Turbo defaults to de_turbo (distillation correction; inference usually needs 20-30 steps). Raw recommends standard (standard RF); if de_turbo is still selected, prepare automatically falls back to standard. frozen_delta: freezes the base model and trains only the LoRA (favoring Turbo's fast inference).
